name: pool file extents
launch_script: set -euo pipefail; dev=$(lsblk -dpno NAME,MODEL | awk '/Instance Storage/ {print $1; exit}'); sudo mkfs.ext4 -q -F -E nodiscard "$dev"; sudo mkdir -p /scratch; sudo mount -o noatime "$dev" /scratch; sudo chown ubuntu:ubuntu /scratch; sudo apt-get install -y -qq fio
